title: Soft Deletes, Model Events aur Observers
objectives: Mass update par events na chalne ka rule samajhna

sections.heading: Soft deletes
sections.body: Kabhi record delete karna final nahi hona chahiye (jaise order ya product). **Soft delete** mein row hat nahi jaati, bas `deleted_at` bhar jaata hai, aur normal queries use dikhati nahi.

code.code:
$product->delete();                      // soft delete: deleted_at bhara

Product::all();                         // deleted wale nahi aate
Product::withTrashed()->get();          // sab, deleted bhi
Product::onlyTrashed()->get();          // sirf deleted

$product->trashed();                    // true/false
$product->restore();                    // wapas laao
$product->forceDelete();                // hamesha ke liye delete

explain: Pehle migration mein `softDeletes()` aur model mein `SoftDeletes` trait dono chahiye.
Piche `SoftDeletes` ek global scope lagata hai (pichhle lesson jaisa).
Route model binding mein soft deleted model 404 deta hai (`->withTrashed()` se badal sakte ho).

sections.heading: Model events
sections.body: Eloquent model ke lifecycle ke har step par event bhejta hai: `retrieved`, `creating`, `created`, `updating`, `updated`, `saving`, `saved`, `deleting`, `deleted`, `restoring`, `restored`. `-ing` events kaam hone se pehle chalte hain, `-ed` baad mein.

callout.text: Mass update/delete (`Product::where(...)->update(...)`) events nahi chalate, kyunki models load hi nahi hote. Events chahiye to models load karke instance par update/delete karo.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Observer
sections.body: Event ka code model ko bhari bana deta hai. Observer ek alag class hai jisme tum in events par kaam rakhte ho. Product banate waqt slug banana aur delete hone par log likhna:

code.code:
<?php

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class ProductObserver
{
    public function creating(Product $product): void
    {
        $product->slug = Str::slug($product->name);
    }

    public function deleted(Product $product): void
    {
        logger("Product {$product->id} delete hua");
    }
}

explain: Observer ke method ka naam event ka naam hota hai (`creating`, `deleted`...).
Observer ko register karna padta hai: model par `#[ObservedBy]` ya `AppServiceProvider::boot()` mein `observe()`. `make:observer` khud register nahi karta.

versionDiff.heading: Soft deletes aur observers: Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: `SoftDeletes`, model events aur observers teeno versions mein same kaam karte hain.

items.11: `#[ObservedBy]` ya `Model::observe()` se observer register hota hai. `make:observer` register nahi karta.
items.13: Same as 11. Model par attribute-based config (jaise `#[ObservedBy]`) 13 ke naye style ke saath achhi tarah baithta hai.

errors.error: SQLSTATE[42S22]: Column not found: 1054 Unknown column 'products.deleted_at'
errors.cause: Model mein `SoftDeletes` hai par table mein `deleted_at` column nahi.

errors.error: Observer ka method chal hi nahi raha
errors.cause: Observer register nahi kiya, ya mass update use kiya (events nahi chalte).
errors.fix: `#[ObservedBy]` ya `observe()` jodo; instance par `save()`/`delete()` use karo.

errors.cause: Soft deleted model normal queries aur route binding mein skip hota hai.

debug.body: Observer chal raha hai ya nahi, log se dekho.

code.code:
tail -f storage/logs/laravel.log
php artisan tinker
>>> App\Models\Product::first()->delete()

exercise.intro: Product ko safe aur smart banao:
tasks: Migration mein `softDeletes()` jodo aur model mein `SoftDeletes` trait lagao
Observer ko register karo aur ek product banakar slug check karo

quiz.q: Soft delete mein row ka kya hota hai?
quiz.why: Row rehti hai, bas `deleted_at` timestamp set hota hai.

quiz.q: Deleted records bhi laane ke liye?
quiz.why: `withTrashed()` soft deleted rows bhi laata hai.

interview.a: Record asli mein delete nahi hota, `deleted_at` set hota hai aur normal queries use skip karti hain, to restore kar sakte hain.
SoftDeletes ke saath `delete()` soft delete karta hai. `forceDelete()` row hamesha ke liye hata deta hai.
Eloquent ke lifecycle ke events: creating, created, updating, updated, saving, saved, deleting, deleted, restoring, restored.
Event handling ka code model se alag, ek jagah rehta hai, to model patla rehta hai.

interview.q: Mass update par events kyun nahi chalte?
interview.a: Kyunki model instances load hi nahi hote, seedha SQL chalta hai.

summary: `-ing` events pehle, `-ed` events baad mein chalte hain.
Observer register karna padta hai: `#[ObservedBy]` ya `observe()`.
